// superitems.js // license: NCSA // copyright: JoshJ5Hawk // website: https://www.guilded.gg/senkospub // name: SuperItems // description: Making a few rediculous Items // version: 0.0.5 // author/(s): // - JoshJ5Hawk with help from DigitalBarrito and others on Guilded “use strict”;
